turns.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics, part of Pretty Good AI. How may I help you today?
Hi, yeah, I need some help with an appointment I have scheduled. Can you assist me with that?
Can I have your full name and date of birth?
Sure, my name’s Asher Pranay Palle, and my date of birth is February 16, 1995.
Just to confirm, I have your name as Asher Pauly and your date of birth as February 16th, 1995. Is that correct? If so, please spell your first and last name for me.
Sure, let me spell it out. First name: A-S-H-E-R. Last name: P-A-L-L-E.
Thanks, Asher. How can I help with your appointment? Do you want to confirm, reschedule, or cancel it?
I actually need to cancel it completely, I’m feeling better and don’t need it anymore.
You have an appointment with Judy Hauser on Thursday, September 17th. Is this the one you want to cancel?
Yeah, that sounds right. I’d like to go ahead and cancel that appointment completely.
Your appointment with Sugi Hauser on Thursday, September 17th, has been cancelled. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that takes care of it. Thanks for your help. You have a good one.
You're all set! Have a great day!
Thanks, you too. Take care, bye.
